title: The next level after Claude projects: building a personal knowledgebase
description: If you are an entrepreneur or knowledge worker, the next level after using Claude projects is to start a personal knowledge base using Obsidian or Notion, then letting Claude sit on top of it. I use to run my business, career and personal notes - all in one place. For most people this is the next big unlock.
